+"""Interactive control log/controller for the BEHAVIOR limited-mode episode.
+
+Run with: python -u /app/output/gen.py
+Commands are JSON lines on stdin. Every response is printed as JSON and every
+observation/action result is saved under /app/runs.
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = "/app/runs"
+os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
+r = Robot()
+print(json.dumps({"spec": r.spec()}), flush=True)
+counter = 0
+
+
+def save_result(result, label):
+    global counter
+    counter += 1
+    path = os.path.join(OUT, f"{counter:03d}_{label}")
+    result.save(path)
+    print(json.dumps({"saved": path, "meta": result.meta,
+                      "last_proprio": (result.proprio[-1].tolist() if result.proprio is not None
+                                       and result.proprio.ndim > 1 else None)}), flush=True)
+
+
+initial = r.get_obs()
+save_result(initial, "initial")
+for line in sys.stdin:
+    try:
+        cmd = json.loads(line)
+        op = cmd["op"]
+        if op == "obs":
+            result = r.get_obs(seconds=float(cmd.get("seconds", 0)),
+                               video=cmd.get("video", "frames"))
+            save_result(result, "obs")
+        elif op == "joint":
+            result = r.submit("joint_position", np.asarray(cmd["actions"], dtype=np.float32),
+                              dt=float(cmd.get("dt", 1/30)),
+                              interpolate=cmd.get("interpolate", "hold"),
+                              video=cmd.get("video", "mp4"),
+                              note=cmd.get("note", ""))
+            save_result(result, "joint")
+        elif op == "ee":
+            result = r.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(cmd["actions"], dtype=np.float32),
+                              video=cmd.get("video", "mp4"), note=cmd.get("note", ""))
+            save_result(result, "ee")
+        elif op == "quit":
+            break
+        else:
+            print(json.dumps({"error": f"unknown op {op}"}), flush=True)
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(json.dumps({"error": repr(e)}), flush=True)
*** End Patch";
